assumptions: Seven science packs at the stated rate each, including physics and electromagnetic science; all pre-physics routes available; no modules or beacons.

Resolved collision boxes rounded up to tile footprints. Machine margins allow local pipes, belts and inserters. Shared space reserves allow corridors, buffers and stations; these are layout assumptions, not a routed blueprint.
Tier-1 batteries start full and cover a 30-second gap for ordinary loads only. Batteries are packed without per-machine margins; shared space reserves still apply.
Island area excludes sediment. Rocks can be cleared. Cliff-free area conservatively subtracts cliff bounding boxes; clearable area assumes cliff explosives.
32x32 blocks are disjoint squares on a fixed grid. Boundary islands are truncated; their measured area is a lower bound.
The sand power grid is a measured reference layout, not a proven power solution for the requested factory. Do not scale its generation as guaranteed power.
No island filling is assumed. No construction mall, expansion stock, train length, or inter-island rail route is sized. Shared-space allowances do not prove station geometry fits.
